subject: Co-sell SLA handshake + marketplace evidence & governance
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@brightanalytics.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@brightanalytics.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing: evidence for support coverage & co-sell SLA

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked promising and our GTM team wants to start the listing preflight. Before we proceed we need a short package of evidence for BrightAnalytics marketplace review and to scope the co-sell integration. Specifically we need:

- Confirmation of support coverage offered to marketplace customers (standard and optional tiers) and the escalation path (email, phone/PD, response windows).
- Any public claims we use on the listing (e.g., 99.9% availability, 24/7 support) plus backing artifacts (SLA PDFs or historical uptime reports).
- Legal/branding assets showing logo usage rules and trademark permissions for marketplace banners.
- A point of contact for joint co-sell motions (channel lead) and a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones.

Can you send an initial checklist and any artifacts you can share under NDA? BrightAnalytics runs a standard review that usually takes 5 business days once we have docs.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Partner Programs
BrightAnalytics

--
Attachment: none in this email

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@brightanalytics.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: evidence for support coverage & co-sell SLA

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Camila (legal/partner ops) and Marissa (co-sell) to give the artifacts and confirm the MAP.

Quick response to your bullets:
- Support tiers: our default marketplace offering maps to Redwood Standard Support (business hours, 24x5 email + 4 hour P1 response window). 24x7 support is an add-on available on Dedicated and Private contracts.
- Availability claim: we can provide the SLA PDF that states a 99.5% monthly availability for hosted API; Dedicated contracts have per-commit SLAs. I will attach the current SLA and the uptime report for the last 90 days.
- Branding: attaching logo guidelines and trademark permission brief. Legal notes below.
- MAP: propose a one-page MAP draft — I'll attach a checklist (spreadsheet) with owners and target dates.

Deliverables attached: RA-marketplace-checklist.xlsx (MAP + artifacts list), redwood-logo-guidelines.pdf, support-slo-mapping.csv

Next steps: please confirm which support tier you expect customers to see by default on the BrightAnalytics portal (Standard vs Premium), and we can align the public copy.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference
+1 415-555-0183

--
Attachments: RA-marketplace-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-logo-guidelines.pdf (PDF), support-slo-mapping.csv (CSV)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@brightanalytics.io>; Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: evidence for support coverage & co-sell SLA

Samantha — adding the legal perspective. A few clarifications and requests from our side so the listing review goes smoothly:

1) Trademark & logo: the attached PDF contains exact usage rules. For marketplace banners we require a co-branded lockup — please confirm BrightAnalytics's preferred placement and we will supply the SVGs.
2) Public claims: If you want "99.9%" verbage on the marketplace tile, we need to change our hosted SLA or qualify the claim (e.g., "targeting 99.9% depending on plan"). We can supply the 90-day availability report but will not sign off on an unqualified 99.9% statement for hosted by default.
3) Support SLOs: our standard marketplace copy will show "Email support: business hours (24x5). P1 response target: 4 hours". For customers that purchase Premium/Dedicated we list 24x7 phone + 1 hour P1 response.
4) Evidence: please include the following in the artifacts bundle for your ops review: SOC2 Type II summary (redacted), an uptime CSV (we provided), incident runbook summary for P1s, and a named escalation contact for channel ops.

We do require a signed Co-Sell Addendum for any co-sell revenue split > 20% or where BrightAnalytics will be selling on our behalf. Marissa — can you handle MAP timelines and attach the addendum draft?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-logo-guidelines.pdf

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@brightanalytics.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: evidence for support coverage & co-sell SLA

Thanks Camila — that breakdown is helpful. For BrightAnalytics marketplace policy we can accept the qualified availability line (i.e., we prefer accuracy over copy that overpromises). Our ops team confirmed they need:

- SOC2 Type II summary (redacted ok)
- 90-day uptime CSV (you indicated you have it)
- Incident runbook high-level (for P1 escalation)
- Named escalation contact and on-call roster for Premium customers (if 24x7 is listed)

Regarding co-sell addendum: our legal will review your draft. For the MAP, we want the initial listing to target going live by Aug 20 if all artifacts are received by Aug 6. Is that timeline feasible on your side?

Samantha
Partner Programs, BrightAnalytics

--

Samantha — confirmed. We can hit your MAP dates with the following commitments:

Action items (owners & dates):
- Aug 4: Deliver redacted SOC2 summary, uptime CSV, and incident runbook summary (Owner: Camila)
- Aug 5: Marissa to send MAP one-pager and draft Co-Sell Addendum for legal review (Owner: Marissa)
- Aug 6: BrightAnalytics to confirm default support tier for listing (Standard vs Premium) and approve co-branded tile layout (Owner: Samantha)
- Aug 20: Target live listing (contingent on approvals and signed addendum)

Attachments included again for convenience: RA-marketplace-checklist.xlsx, support-slo-mapping.csv

If Bright wants the listing to show 24x7 by default we need a signed addendum and purchase of Premium before the tile goes live — otherwise we will list Standard (24x5) and include an upgrade CTA.

Thanks — will post the MAP doc to the shared drive and tag your ops team.

Regards,
Jonas
Head of Partnerships
